faq_heading: Homes near George Greenaway Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the George Greenaway Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the George Greenaway Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names George Greenaway Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near George Greenaway Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 77 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,195,000, townhomes $870,000, condos $295,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near George Greenaway Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of George Greenaway Elementary the median was 18 days on the market, closing at 96.2% of the list price, with 1% of sales above the list price for the 77 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to George Greenaway Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Cloverdale Catholic School (0.6 km south-east), Traditional Learning Academy Online (1.0 km south-east) and SD 36 Alternate Cloverdale LC (1.1 km south-east).

George Greenaway Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 17285 61a Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names George Greenaway Elementary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 1 km of the school.
How the George Greenaway Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names George Greenaway Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of George Greenaway Elementary sold for

Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 77 homes sold within 1 km of George Greenaway Elementary: 40 houses, 25 townhomes and 10 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,195,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of George Greenaway Elementary

14 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of George Greenaway Elementary in a straight line (9 elementary, 3 secondary, 2 other; 3 independent). The closest is Cloverdale Catholic School, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is Sunrise Ridge Elementary, 2.8 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is SD 36 Alternate Cloverdale LC (1.1 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Martha Currie Elementary (2.3 km). Other elementary schools close by: Cloverdale Catholic School (0.6 km south-east), Surrey Centre Elementary (1.3 km west), Cloverdale Traditional (1.5 km south-east), A J McLellan Elementary (1.5 km west), Don Christian Elementary (2.2 km east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Cloverdale Catholic School, 0.6 km south-east of George Greenaway Elementary.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 1 km of George Greenaway Elementary was $1,195,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
